title: Senior Data Architect
description:
CSS Innovation Studios is seeking Senior Data Engineers/Architects with deep expertise in PySpark and data engineering to deliver strategic AI and data-transformation programs for Oracle’s largest enterprise customers.

In this senior, customer-facing role, you will design, build, modernize, and operationalize enterprise-scale data platforms and AI-driven data solutions on Oracle AI Data Platform (AIDP) and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). You will work directly with CIOs, CDOs, CTOs, chief architects, engineering leaders, and Oracle product teams to accelerate AI adoption, modernize legacy data estates, and deliver secure, high-performing production solutions.

The role combines hands-on software and data engineering with technical consulting. You will develop scalable systems supporting generative AI, large language models, real-time analytics, and modern data workloads; lead complex platform implementations and migrations; and partner with architects, product managers, and engineers to apply and evolve Oracle product capabilities through real-world customer deployments.

* 10–12+ years of experience designing, architecting, and delivering enterprise-scale data platforms.
* Proven experience as a Senior Data Engineer, Data Architect, Principal Solution Architect, Consulting Engineer, or technical leader in professional services.
* Expert knowledge of one or more modern cloud data platforms like Databricks
* Extensive hands-on experience with Apache Spark, PySpark, Delta Lake, Python, SQL, Scala or Java, Kafka and modern data ecosystems.
* Exposure to building autonomous agents and orchestration pipelines.
* Deep expertise in Spark architecture, configuration, distributed systems, performance engineering, optimization, and tuning at scale.
* Demonstrated success modernizing enterprise analytics platforms and refactoring Spark and ETL workloads.
* Must have a solid understanding of networking concepts to design and optimize data transmission networks, configure network settings, and diagnose and resolve network-related issues.
* Strong understanding of DataOps, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, data security, governance, metadata, lineage, and observability.
* Outstanding executive communication, customer advisory, and stakeholder-management skills.

  

Lead architecture and delivery of enterprise Oracle AI Data Platform transformations, including platform implementations and migrations.

* Design and build scalable, governed, AI-ready data architectures, software components, and services for data consolidation, integration, transformation, and data products.
* Develop Lakehouse, Medallion, streaming, and real-time analytics solutions on OCI using technologies such as Spark, PySpark, Delta Lake, Parquet, Flink, and distributed-systems patterns.
* Build AI/ML and Generative AI data pipelines, including feature engineering, feature extraction, MLOps workflows, and vector-ready datasets.
* Assess and modernize workloads by refactoring PySpark and ETL code and optimizing Spark configuration, cluster sizing, partitioning, memory, adaptive query execution, reliability, and performance at scale.
* Develop APIs, SDKs, web applications, and automation frameworks that simplify adoption of Oracle AI Data Platform and Generative AI services.
* Create reusable migration accelerators, reference architectures, automation frameworks, and delivery methodologies.
* Collaborate with engineering, product, and field teams to solve complex technical challenges; share customer insights to inform product roadmaps.
* Serve as a trusted technical advisor throughout customer engagements.
* Mentor senior engineers globally, promote engineering excellence across CSS, and continuously evaluate emerging AI, cloud, and data-engineering practices.

title: Senior Core Infrastructure Engineer
description:
The Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) team offers the opportunity to build and operate a suite of massive-scale, coordinated cloud services in a broadly distributed, multi-tenant environment. OCI delivers cloud products that support customers tackling some of the world’s most complex and business-critical challenges.

OCI Infrastructure Delivery Engineering is a growing organization responsible for building services and tools that accelerate how OCI expands its compute and network capacity. Our platform supports the end-to-end lifecycle of data centers and their physical assets—from planning and design, through delivery and operation, to eventual decommissioning. It enables OCI to scale efficiently in existing regions and launch new regions while meeting the high-capacity demands of large and hyperscale customers.

We are looking for a talented and passionate Senior Software Development Engineer to help design, build, and operate this foundational platform. You will work on highly available, scalable services that manage physical assets throughout their lifecycle. This is a greenfield environment with significant autonomy to innovate, while integrating with OCI systems through established service contracts.

You will be a hands-on engineer who enjoys solving challenging distributed-systems problems, values simplicity and customer impact, and takes ownership of quality in production. You will collaborate closely with engineers and partner teams to deliver reliable services that help OCI continue to grow its global footprint.

  

About You

* You are a cloud development engineer who has contributed to high-scale, high-impact solutions.
* You are customer-focused and consistently look for ways to exceed expectations.
* You communicate technical concepts clearly and work effectively with diverse partners.
* You hold yourself and your work to a high standard, continuously seeking better engineering outcomes.
* You are comfortable operating in an evolving environment and can bring structure to ambiguity.
* You are passionate about technology, able to advocate for your ideas constructively, and open to evidence-based alternatives.

Minimum Qualifications

* BS/Btech in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of professional software development experience, including 1+ year designing, delivering, or operating scalable, cloud-native distributed systems.
* Proficiency in one or more high-level programming languages, preferably Go and/or Java; working knowledge of scripting or automation languages such as Python.
* Experience contributing to products from the ground up through the full software development lifecycle.
* Understanding of microservice design patterns, service-to-service communication protocols, and techniques for building highly reliable services.
* Familiarity with service observability, including dashboards, critical service metrics, alarms, and operational health indicators.
* Strong grasp of computer science fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, and programming paradigms.
* Experience with production operations and practices for safely deploying quality code, participating in on-call rotations, and troubleshooting incidents.
* Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, cross-functional team environment.
* Ability to communicate technical ideas verbally and in writing through design documents, proposals, architecture diagrams, and presentations.

Preferred Qualifications

* MTech or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Experience in a fast-paced engineering environment.
* Experience building control-plane or data-plane solutions for cloud-native platforms.
* Experience diagnosing and resolving performance, reliability, or scaling issues in complex distributed environments.
* Understanding of the physical asset lifecycle in a cloud-scale data center.
* Experience with Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM) systems or related tools.
* Experience with Kubernetes and containerized workloads.
* Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code, preferably Terraform.
* Familiarity with modern infrastructure components such as service discovery, secret storage, containerization, and software-defined networking.

Responsibilities

* Design, implement, test, deploy, and operate services and tools that accelerate OCI compute and network capacity growth.
* Work with engineers and partner teams to define and deliver reliable, scalable capabilities for the physical asset lifecycle.
* Investigate issues across the stack, resolve root causes, and improve service reliability, performance, and operational readiness.
* Apply sound distributed-systems and cloud-infrastructure principles to deliver resilient production services.
* Build and maintain meaningful service telemetry, dashboards, alarms, and runbooks to support operational excellence.
* Participate in on-call rotations and incident response; use operational learnings to drive durable improvements.
* Contribute to technical designs, architecture discussions, code reviews, and engineering standards.
* Balance speed and quality through iterative, incremental delivery and thoughtful prioritization.
* Work independently on well-defined problems and provide technical mentorship and support to junior engineers.
* Communicate progress, risks, and technical trade-offs clearly, and help build consensus using data and sound engineering judgment.

* Define and champion operational-excellence standards, including observability, service health, incident learning, capacity planning, and reliability goals.
* Identify systemic risks, technical debt, and scaling bottlenecks; prioritize improvements using customer impact and data-driven analysis.

* Influence major decisions for new and existing products, build consensus around trade-offs, and communicate decisions clearly to stakeholders.

title: Director, Software Engineering
description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

**Job Summary**
===============

The Acceptance Solutions Product Development team are the engineers responsible for a portfolio of products that drive diversification of Visa revenue, differentiate our network, and deliver value-added solutions across other rails. This is part of a strategy to increase total merchant value by developing solutions that address complex and emerging needs of both merchants and acquirers. Our mission is to drive the future of payment acceptance, helping our clients navigate digital commerce complexities and address an increasing need for flexibility and agility.

The goal of the Visa Acceptance Platform is to be the world’s most open payment platform by delivering market leading, globally relevant, omnichannel acceptance componentry through open, composable, modular APIs delivered with Visa-grade resilience, security, maintenance, and scale.

We are seeking a dynamic, hands-on engineering leader to lead teams building secure, high-performing distributed systems for payment acceptance. Our technology stack includes Java, Containers, Kafka, relational databases, Docker, Kubernetes, and modern cloud-native engineering practices. The ideal candidate brings strong software engineering depth, proven people leadership, and the ability to stay close to day-to-day design, code, architecture, delivery, and operational decisions while partnering with architecture, product, security, and operations teams to deliver resilient platforms at scale.

This role requires a leader who can balance strategic direction with active hands-on engineering involvement, apply AI/ML and Generative AI to improve engineering productivity and business outcomes, and mentor engineers to grow their technical capabilities and careers. This is an opportunity to lead talented teams while remaining deeply engaged in the technical details that shape secure, scalable payment acceptance. Be a part of our mission to shape the future of secure payments.

**Essential Functions**
=======================

* Serve as the hands-on technical lead for Payment Processing Platform across the Visa Acceptance Platform, providing technical direction across architecture, design, implementation, scalability, resiliency, and operational readiness.
* Lead the design, implementation, and deployment of secure, reliable, robust, and interoperable payment acceptance products.
* Provide engineering leadership to ensure solutions align with platform principles, architecture standards, and Visa-grade availability, resiliency, and operational excellence expectations.
* Remain actively hands-on with architecture, design reviews, code reviews, proof-of-concepts, performance analysis, debugging, technical troubleshooting, production-readiness, and critical delivery decisions on a day-to-day basis.
* Apply AI/ML, Generative AI, automation, and intelligent engineering practices to improve software delivery, search relevance, analytics capabilities, operational insight, developer productivity, and business outcomes.
* Define and execute the technical strategy for payment processing and acceptance platforms in alignment with product vision, business priorities, and long-term platform evolution.
* Drive delivery of fit-for-purpose products and platform capabilities that improve time-to-market while maintaining security, quality, scalability, and reliability.
* Design and evolve secure, reliable, and scalable search, indexing, analytics, enrichment, and data-processing capabilities that support high-volume payment acceptance use cases.
* Provide technical leadership for modern, intuitive, secure, and performant user interfaces that enable search, analytics, reporting, operational insights, and data-driven workflows for internal and external users.
* Set technical direction for event-driven data flows, transaction enrichment, search indexing, analytics pipelines, user-facing dashboards, observability, and operational insights in alignment with product, platform, security, user experience, and business objectives.
* Lead technical design for event correlation, transaction matching, retry handling, dead-letter queues, replay, idempotency, exactly-once processing considerations, and high-throughput data movement.
* Establish and continuously improve engineering best practices for application development, testing, deployment, observability, monitoring, incident response, and operational readiness, strengthening reliability, performance, maintainability, developer productivity, and operational excellence across Search and Analytics capabilities.
* Partner with application, data, platform, product, regional, business, client-facing, security, privacy, risk, governance, compliance, and operations teams to translate requirements into high-quality solutions that meet functional and non-functional requirements (security, latency, availability, compliance, maintainability) and applicable policies, standards, regulatory expectations, and customer commitments.
* Communicate and present technical strategy, tradeoffs, risks, dependencies, delivery progress, and recommendations clearly, adapting to audiences that include executive leaders, business partners, product partners, architecture forums, and engineering teams.
* Coach, mentor, and develop engineers, senior engineers, technical leads, and engineering leaders through regular feedback, design reviews, architecture discussions, hands-on problem solving, technical deep dives, brown bag sessions, tech talks, production troubleshooting, and career development conversations.
* Build and lead high-performing teams by promoting collaboration, constructive debate, accountability, inclusion, and execution excellence consistent with Visa Leadership Principles.
* Bring forward new ideas, engineering improvements, and technology recommendations that increase team effectiveness, improve developer productivity, and advance platform capabilities.
* Influence technical strategy across teams without relying on formal reporting authority, using strong engineering judgment, collaboration, credibility, and hands-on technical depth.

**Qualifications**

**Basic Qualifications**
========================

* 10+ years of relevant work experience and a Bachelors degree, OR 13+ years of relevant work experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* 12 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or 8-10 years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 6+ years of work experience with a PhD.
* Demonstrated success leading high-performing, multi-disciplinary, and geographically distributed software engineering teams, including people management, coaching, performance development, delivery accountability, and hiring, developing, and retaining senior technical talent.
* Deep experience designing, building, and operating globally distributed, mission-critical systems that require high availability, scalability, resiliency, and security, and that support very high transaction volumes with strict availability, latency, security, and compliance requirements.
* Proven ability to solve complex technical and organizational problems across multiple domains, systems, and teams.
* Experience setting technical direction, influencing architecture and delivery strategy, and aligning engineering execution with product and business objectives.
* Strong proficiency in modern software engineering practices, programming languages, API design, system design, testing, deployment, and operational excellence, with a strong hands-on background in API-first software product development using technologies such as Java/J2EE, Spring Boot, Vert.x, REST, Kafka, Hazelcast, Git, Maven, CI/CD pipelines, and test automation.
* Recent hands-on experience with architecture, design, coding practices, code reviews, debugging, production support, and technical decision-making in complex software systems.
* Experience with cloud platforms, Kubernetes, containerized deployment models, and modern DevOps practices.
* Experience with event-driven architecture, streaming platforms such as Kafka, and high-throughput transaction or data processing systems, including resilient patterns such as event correlation, transaction matching, retry mechanisms, dead-letter queues, replay, idempotency, and exactly-once processing considerations.
* Experience delivering secure software platforms, including familiarity with authentication, authorization, encryption, identity, and secure engineering practices.
* rack record of mentoring engineers, developing technical leaders, and building strong engineering culture.
* Experience applying AI-enabled engineering practices, automation, or developer productivity improvements across software delivery teams, and implementing, deploying, or governing AI/ML, Generative AI, or agentic AI capabilities in production environments or engineering workflows.
* Experience in payments, financial services, fintech, or high-scale transaction processing environments, including payment processing, transaction lifecycle concepts, payment network protocols, and acceptance workflows.
* Experience partnering with executive leadership, product leaders, technical product managers, regional teams, and business stakeholders to define strategy, roadmaps, requirements, priorities, and delivery plans.

* Strong experience with agile delivery, software development lifecycle practices, engineering metrics, continuous improvement, developer productivity, and operational performance management.
* Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, and influencing skills, with the ability to form, advocate, and communicate an independent technical viewpoint grounded in hands-on engineering experience.
* Long-term strategic thinker who stays current with emerging technologies and translates them into practical engineering and business outcomes.
* Highly driven, resourceful, results-oriented, and collaborative, with strong communication skills and a focus on durable, win-win outcomes.

title: MGR SYSTEMS ARCHITECT - INDIA
description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

**The Role**
------------

Team Management: Mgr. Systems Architects manage a team of 6 to 10 Sr. system architects, lead architects, and associate managers, assigning them to the right Agile Release Trains (ARTs).
  
Guidance and Mentorship: They guide and enable the team to deliver designs efficiently, mentor reportees, and ensure they contribute towards achieving business goals and managing technical debt.
  
Architectural Oversight: They oversee system design and roadmap, drive architectural initiatives, identify opportunities for optimization, and ensure designs adhere to Lumen Enterprise IT guidelines.
  
Coordination Across ARTs: Mgr. Systems Architects ensure technology alignments across ARTs, confirm capabilities meet Definition of Ready (DoR), and review estimates and critical features by working with other architects.
  
Production Performance and Stability: They maintain full awareness of application performance in production environments, participate in SWAT calls to address stability issues, and help document root causes.
  
Engagement and Collaboration: They engage with system architects, outside vendors, and various teams to review and ensure the success of designs, and participate in Continuous Exploration processes.

**The Main Responsibilities**
-----------------------------

* Manage a team of 6 to 10 Sr. system architects / lead architects / associate mgr system architects and assign to right ARTs.
* Guide and enable the team to deliver designs efficiently
* Enable system architects in the team to own and contribute towards achieving business goals and technical debt.
* Understand overall system design and roadmap
* Drive architectural initiatives and identify opportunities for optimization
* Oversee, mentor and guide reportees.
* Identify areas where POCs are required and assign to reportees as appropriate and track the same to completion.
* Mgr System Architects manage reportees working across ARTs.
* Ensure technology alignments across ARTs; align teams of multiple ARTs to a shared technical direction by working with respective ART System architects
* Confirm Capability meets Definition of Ready (DoR) before approving for multiple ARTs
* Attend and participate in Mass Markets Architecture Review Boards
* Review Capability estimates by working closely with other system architects across ARTs.
* Ensure ART system designs adhere to Lumen Enterprise IT roadmap, guidelines, principles
* Review critical enabler Features and NFRs created by ART architects
* Engage with other system architects and establish an integrated technical design
* Engage with outside vendors to ensure design success
* Engage system architects to review designs and ensure complete end to end success (ie. Omni channel, flow through, etc.)
* Actively participate in the Continuous Exploration (keeping up with the industry) process as part of the Continuous Delivery Pipeline, especially with Enabler Epics
* Collaborate with their application/service development team, Load and Performance team, chaos engineering team, SRE SPOC etc.
* Have full awareness of application/service performance in production environment, upstream / downstream applications, database performance characteristics etc.
* Participate in Proactive / Reactive SWAT calls to address production stability issues, help teams on identifying and documenting accurate root cause of issues.
* Review ART technical enabler Feature content
* Review ART environment performance, stability, and scalability targets
* Review critical nonfunctional requirements. Provide inputs based on production stability, performance issues, bottle necks, User experience issues, security etc.
* Review ART system designs focused on system components which align to the larger end state designs
* Review ART technical system design documents
* Review deisgn of subsystems and their interfaces; allocate responsibilities to subsystems; understand design deployment; communicate requirements for interactions within design context.
* Review ART data flow, sources, storage, format
* Review technical and architectural vision for the ARTs and provide inputs to system architects

**What We Look For in a Candidate**
-----------------------------------

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  

* Minimum 10 years of software development experience, with deep expertise in C#, .NET / .NET Core, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework / EF Core, and LINQ.
* At least 3 years in a solution/application architect role, an engineering manager role, or both.
* Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise applications on Microsoft Azure.
* Strong expertise in microservices, API design, distributed systems, and design patterns (including SOLID, domain-driven design, CQRS, and event-driven architecture).
* Deep experience with Microsoft SQL Server: data modeling, complex T-SQL, stored procedures, indexing, query and performance tuning, execution plans, and transaction and locking behavior.
* Experience with GitHub, GitHub Actions, and modern CI/CD and DevOps practices.
* Strong knowledge of application security, including OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, Azure AD / Entra ID, secrets management, and secure handling of sensitive financial data.
* Experience with observability and production support tools such as Application Insights and Azure Monitor.
* Experience leading Agile/Scrum teams using Jira (Confluence is a plus).
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience working across time zones with US-based leadership and business teams.

Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills
  

* AI/ML: experience designing or delivering AI/ML or LLM-powered solutions (RAG, agents, Semantic Kernel, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning).
* Palantir: exposure to Palantir Foundry or AIP.
* Python: hands-on experience with Python for services, automation, or data work.
* Multi-cloud: experience architecting across AWS or Google Cloud in addition to Azure.
* Containers and orchestration with Docker and Kubernetes (AKS).
* Infrastructure as Code with Terraform or Bicep.
* Front-end architecture experience with Angular, React, or Blazor.
* Experience with messaging and streaming platforms (Azure Service Bus, Event Grid, Kafka).
* Domain knowledge in billing, payments, invoicing, collections, revenue management, or other financial systems, ideally in telecom or large enterprise.

  

What We're Looking For
  

* A leader who balances hands-on technical depth with strong people management.
* A strategic thinker who can set a clear technical direction and turn it into practical delivery plans.
* Someone who builds trust across teams and time zones through clear, proactive communication.
* A mentor who enjoys developing engineers and raising the bar for the whole team.
* Someone excited to help the team adopt cloud and AI in a responsible, business-focused way.

title: Senior Manager - System Validation
description:
Overview:

**ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.**

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

Responsibilities:

**THE ROLE:**

We are looking for a Senior Manager to lead System Validation for BIOS, Firmware and Driver validation activities across our embedded product portfolio. This role will provide hands-on technical leadership, drive validation coverage, strengthen test planning and execution discipline, and ensure timely visibility to critical issues, risks and customer-impacting defects. The leader will work closely with development, silicon IP enablement, silicon validation, platform and customer-facing teams to ensure validation readiness, reduce test escapes and improve engineering effectiveness through scale and AI-driven initiatives.

**THE PERSON**

* A strong technical validation leader with deep understanding of system-level validation across BIOS, firmware, drivers and platform software stacks.
* Demonstrates ownership in defining validation coverage, test strategy, execution governance and defect triage for complex silicon and platform programs.
* Builds trusted networks across client and server ecosystems, development teams, silicon IP enablement teams and validation organizations to improve end-to-end product readiness.
* Balances technical depth with people leadership, helping the team grow in capability, execution maturity, collaboration and customer orientation.
* Brings a continuous improvement mindset with the ability to drive scale, automation, traceability and AI-enabled productivity across validation workflows.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Provide technical leadership for system validation activities covering BIOS, firmware and driver validation across assigned embedded programs.
* Define and drive the right validation coverage by partnering with architecture, development, silicon IP enablement, silicon validation, platform and customer enablement teams.
* Own test management discipline including validation planning, test readiness, execution tracking, completion governance and timely reporting of progress, gaps and risks.
* Drive first-level triage for critical issues by ensuring structured debug data collection, clear ownership alignment, prioritization and timely handoff to the appropriate development teams.
* Establish strong collaboration forums with BIOS, firmware, driver, silicon IP, silicon validation and platform teams to close coverage gaps and improve defect discovery earlier in the lifecycle.
* Build and maintain technical connects in the client and server spaces from which the group leverages devices, ecosystems, validation methodologies and learnings.
* Reduce validation escapes through improved test strategy, coverage analysis, defect trend reviews, regression rigor and disciplined exit criteria.
* Support customer escalations and critical field issue triage as required, ensuring responsiveness, technical clarity and coordinated execution across engineering owners.
* Lead team development by coaching engineers and leads, improving technical depth, strengthening ownership behaviors and building succession for key validation areas.
* Drive scale initiatives across validation execution, including automation, reusable test assets, consistent dashboards, traceability from requirements to tests, and execution efficiency improvements.
* Champion AI initiatives that improve test planning, coverage mapping, traceability, execution tracking, defect analytics, reporting quality and validation productivity.
* Partner with program management and engineering leadership to provide accurate status, risk visibility, decision points and recovery plans for validation milestones.

**PREFERRED EXPERIENCE**

* 20+ years of industry experience with 8+ years of exposure with people management roles
* Experience leading system validation, post-silicon validation, platform validation, BIOS validation, firmware validation or driver validation teams for complex silicon or platform products.
* Strong understanding of validation lifecycle, test plan development, coverage definition, test execution governance, defect management, regression strategy and exit criteria.
* Hands-on familiarity with BIOS, UEFI, firmware, drivers, platform initialization, silicon bring-up, debug flows and system-level validation environments.
* Experience collaborating with silicon IP enablement, silicon validation, firmware, BIOS, driver, platform, architecture and customer-facing teams.
* Demonstrated ability to lead issue triage, drive technical discussions, identify ownership, escalate risks and close critical defects with urgency.
* Experience with customer escalations, field issue debug, escape analysis and corrective action planning.
* Working knowledge of test management tools, defect tracking systems, coverage dashboards, automation frameworks and traceability practices.
* Experience applying automation, data analytics or AI-assisted methods to improve validation planning, execution tracking, reporting or defect insights.
* Prior people management experience with demonstrated ability to hire, coach, develop and retain high-performing validation engineers and leads.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to present validation status, risks, technical issues and execution plans to engineering and business leadership.

**Academic Credentials**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or a related technical discipline.
* Equivalent industry experience in system validation, firmware, BIOS, driver, silicon validation or platform engineering will be considered.

description:
**Company Description**

At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

Join AECOM's Environment consulting practice and play a vital role in shaping some of the world's most significant infrastructure and development programmes.

Based in India, you will work directly with UK and international project teams, helping deliver engagement and consultation strategies for transformational projects across transportation, energy, water, urban development and major infrastructure. title: Cyber Detection Engineer
description:
**About Analog Devices**

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X .

  

**Detection Engineer – Early Career**
=====================================

  
  

**Role Overview**
=================

The Detection Engineer supports the development, testing, tuning, and maintenance of cyber detection capabilities across the Security Operations Centre (SOC). Working closely with SOC analysts, threat intelligence, incident response, and engineering teams, this role helps improve visibility, detection accuracy, and response effectiveness. This is an early-career position designed for individuals looking to build expertise in detection engineering, SIEM content development, threat analytics, and automation. The successful candidate will demonstrate curiosity, analytical reasoning, and the ability to independently investigate why a detection fired, how an attack could occur, and how future detections can be improved.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Support the development, testing, and maintenance of SIEM detection rules, analytics, alerts, and correlation logic.
* Assist with tuning existing detections to reduce false positives and improve detection quality.
* Investigate missed detections and support root-cause analysis activities.
* Work with SOC analysts to understand alert triage outcomes and improve detection content.
* Help onboard new log sources into monitoring platforms and validate data quality and coverage.
* Support detection use-case development using threat intelligence, MITRE ATT&CK, incident findings, and known attack techniques.
* Participate in threat hunting exercises and assist with developing new detection opportunities.
* Assist with maintaining detection engineering documentation, standards, playbooks, and testing records.
* Support development of automation workflows within SIEM, SOAR, and response platforms.
* Assist the SOC in the triage, investigation, and response of security alerts, incidents, and escalations
* Contribute to purple-team, tabletop, and validation exercises to measure effectiveness of detections.
* Track detection performance metrics, including false positives, false negatives, detection coverage, and alert quality.
* Support continuous improvement activities following incidents, audits, and lessons learned reviews.
* Maintain flexibility to support global cybersecurity operations, including participation in management meetings, vendor engagements, support calls, incident response activities, and after-hours escalations across multiple time zones as needed.
  

  

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 1–3 years experience in cybersecurity, IT operations, SOC operations, system administration, or related technical field.
* Understanding of cybersecurity fundamentals including phishing, malware, identity attacks, network attacks, and incident response.
* Knowledge of AI-assisted detection engineering, large language models (LLMs), agentic workflows, and security automation platforms used to improve analyst productivity and detection outcomes.
* Basic knowledge of SIEM platforms and log analysis concepts.
* Understanding of networking fundamentals including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, authentication, and firewalls.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to learn quickly and work effectively within a collaborative team environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Experience with SIEM/SOAR platforms, Microsoft Defender, Azure, AWS, or similar platforms.
* Experience developing, integrating, or operationalizing AI-powered analysis, automation, and agent-based workflows within security operations, incident response, or detection engineering functions.
* Knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK framework.
* Basic scripting experience using Python, PowerShell, KQL, or SQL.
* Security+, SC-200, AZ-500, CySA+, or equivalent certifications.
* Experience participating in labs, CTFs, internships, threat hunting, or cyber research projects.
  

  

**Success Measures**
====================

* Improvement in detection quality and reduction in false positives.
* Successful onboarding and validation of data sources.
* Delivery of new and enhanced detection use cases.
* Contribution to incident-driven detection improvements.
* Accurate documentation and testing of detection logic.

As such, applicants for this position – except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) – may have to go through an export licensing review process.*

title: Service AMC Engineer
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

**A. HVAC Test Rig Service & Maintenance**

* Provide technical service and maintenance support for HVAC testing laboratory equipment and test rigs.
* Carry out preventive and corrective maintenance of:
* HVAC test chambers
* Calorimeter / psychrometric test systems
* Airflow test systems
* Refrigeration test circuits
* Cooling/heating systems
* Condensing units
* AHU / air-handling systems
* Pumps and fans
* Heat exchangers
* Compressors
* Valves and actuators.
* Identify abnormal operation and take corrective action.
* Maintain test rigs in operational condition with minimum downtime.
* Develop preventive maintenance schedules for laboratory equipment.

**B. Instrumentation & Measurement Systems**

* Service and troubleshoot laboratory measurement instruments such as:
* Temperature sensors
* Humidity sensors
* Pressure sensors/transducers
* Differential pressure sensors
* Airflow measurement devices
* Flow meters
* Energy/power meters
* Refrigerant temperature/pressure sensors
* RTDs / thermocouples
* Load cells, wherever applicable.
* Check sensor health and identify abnormal or unstable readings.
* Support sensor replacement and configuration.
* Coordinate calibration activities with approved laboratories.
* Maintain calibration records and instrument history.

**C. Data Acquisition & Control Systems**

* Troubleshoot **DAQ systems, PLCs, controllers, HMI and laboratory control systems**.
* Identify communication failures between sensors, PLC, DAQ and software.
* Support troubleshooting of:
* PLC I/O
* Analog/digital signals
* Communication networks
* Data logging systems
* HMI alarms
* Controller faults
* Software/hardware communication issues.
* Coordinate with system integrators/OEMs for complex software and control-system issues.
* Verify correct data acquisition after repairs.

**D. Refrigeration System Troubleshooting**

* Troubleshoot refrigeration circuits used in HVAC testing facilities.
* Diagnose:
* Compressor problems
* High/low pressure conditions
* Refrigerant leakage
* Refrigerant flow issues
* Expansion valve problems
* Condenser/evaporator performance
* Oil/refrigerant-related issues.
* Check refrigeration operating parameters and identify abnormal trends.
* Support refrigerant recovery, charging and leak testing as per applicable procedures.

**E. Test Chamber & Environmental Control**

* Maintain environmental test chambers and associated systems.
* Monitor and troubleshoot:
* Temperature control
* Humidity control
* Air circulation
* Heating systems
* Cooling systems
* Control valves
* Dampers
* Fans and blowers.
* Support chamber performance verification and validation.
* Ensure the laboratory can achieve required test conditions consistently.

**F. Calibration & Measurement Accuracy**

* Maintain an updated calibration schedule for laboratory instruments.
* Ensure only calibrated/approved instruments are used for testing.
* Support calibration and verification of:
* Temperature
* Pressure
* Humidity
* Airflow
* Electrical power
* Flow
* Other critical measurement parameters.
* Investigate measurement deviations and abnormal readings.
* Support uncertainty/measurement accuracy investigations where applicable.

**G. Breakdown Support**

* Attend laboratory breakdowns and restore equipment operation within the required timeline.
* Diagnose problems systematically rather than replacing components without identifying the root cause.
* Maintain breakdown records.
* Conduct RCA for major or repeated laboratory failures.
* Recommend corrective and preventive actions.
* Maintain critical spare-parts requirements.

Maintain:

* Preventive maintenance records
* Breakdown reports
* Calibration records
* Test-rig history
* Instrument history
* Spare-parts records
* Service reports
* RCA/CAPA reports
* OEM service records
* Test-rig operating checklists.

title: Software Development Engineer II - Multichannel Agents
description:
**About the role**
------------------

Blue Machines AI builds a production AI agent platform that large enterprise customers use to automate customer conversations at scale. Today a single agent may take a phone call, answer a WhatsApp message, pick up a chat on a customer's website, or join a video session — and it has to behave like the same agent everywhere: same knowledge, same business rules, same memory of who the customer is and what they asked for five minutes ago on a different channel.

The Multichannel team owns that layer. We build the channel adapters, the session and conversation model that sits above them, and the media handling that lets an agent move between text, audio, video, images and documents. Every channel has its own protocol, its own constraints and its own way of failing: telephony cares about milliseconds and codecs, WhatsApp about template approvals, 24-hour session windows and delivery receipts, the web widget about reconnects, flaky mobile networks and embedding inside someone else's site. A bug here isn't a broken screen — it's an enterprise customer's support line going silent.

We're hiring an SDE II to help build this team's foundations. You'll design and ship channel integrations end to end, own them in production, and help define the abstractions that make adding the next channel a week of work instead of a quarter.

 **Requirements**  

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Build and own channel integrations — WhatsApp Business Platform (Cloud API), telephony (SIP/PSTN via carriers and CPaaS providers), the embeddable web chat widget, and in-app/web voice and video over WebRTC — from API design through production on-call.
* Design the unified conversation layer: a channel-agnostic session, message and identity model so the agent runtime sees one conversation regardless of where it came from, with clean handling of channel switches (e.g., a call that continues on WhatsApp) and cross-channel context.
* Handle multimodal input and output: text, voice notes, live audio streams, video, images, documents, location, interactive messages (buttons, lists, carousels) — normalising inbound media for the agent and rendering agent responses correctly for each channel's capabilities and limits.
* Build the realtime plumbing: WebSockets/WebRTC for live audio and video, streaming responses to the widget, and the hooks into the voice pipeline (STT, TTS, turn detection, barge-in) owned with Team Orca.
* Make delivery reliable: idempotent webhook ingestion, retries and dead-letter handling, ordering guarantees, delivery/read-status tracking, rate-limit and quality-tier management on WhatsApp, and graceful degradation when a provider is down.
* Ship the web widget as a product: lightweight embeddable SDK, theming and configuration from our Console, reconnect and offline behaviour, attachment uploads, accessibility, and security for running inside third-party pages.
* Own it in production: instrument latency, delivery success and error rates per channel; build dashboards and alerts; debug live incidents across our services, carrier/BSP logs and customer networks.
* Write design docs, review code, and raise the bar on testing for asynchronous, event-driven systems. Use AI coding tools as a normal part of how you work — with no compromise on quality.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 3–6 years building and running backend or full-stack systems in production, with clear ownership of at least one service end to end.
* Strong in one of Python, Go, Node.js/TypeScript or Java, and comfortable reading the others.
* Solid fundamentals in distributed, event-driven systems: queues/streams (Kafka, Redis Streams, RabbitMQ, SQS or similar), async processing, idempotency, retries, and consistency trade-offs.
* Hands-on experience integrating at least one messaging or communication channel — WhatsApp Business API, SMS, telephony/CPaaS (Twilio, Plivo, Exotel, Vonage or similar), or a chat platform — including webhooks, signature verification and provider-specific quirks.
* Working knowledge of realtime protocols: WebSockets, and ideally WebRTC or streaming media.
* Comfortable designing APIs and data models (SQL and NoSQL) that will be used by other teams and by customers.
* Production instincts: you reach for logs, traces and metrics before guessing, and you design for failure because providers will fail.
* Clear written communication — your design docs and incident notes should stand on their own.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Built a chat or voice widget/SDK embedded in third-party websites or mobile apps.
* Experience with SIP, RTP, media servers (FreeSWITCH, Asterisk, LiveKit, Janus, mediasoup) or codecs and audio processing.
* Familiarity with WhatsApp specifics: template messages, 24-hour customer-service window, interactive messages, Flows, BSP integrations, quality ratings and messaging limits.
* Experience with LLM-based or conversational AI products, especially streaming responses or voice agents.
* Exposure to additional channels: RCS, Instagram/Messenger, Telegram, email, or in-app chat.
* Performance and load-testing realtime systems at high concurrency.

**Why Blue Machines**
---------------------

You'll be an early engineer on a new team with a broad charter — the abstractions you design will decide how every future channel gets built. You'll work on hard, visible problems at enterprise scale, close to the architects and the people who own the platform, with real ownership over what ships.

title: Security Data & SIEM Engineer
description:
**Job description:**

**Security Data & SIEM Engineer**
---------------------------------

Johnson Controls is looking for a Security Data & SIEM Engineer to strengthen security visibility across cloud and enterprise environments. In this role, you will help design, tune, and operate the security logging and SIEM capabilities that support threat detection, investigation, and response.

**Role Overview**
-----------------

You will own key parts of the security data pipeline, including log onboarding, normalization, detection content, alert tuning, and integrations with operational workflows. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who can work across security tooling, incident response, and cross-functional partners to improve the quality and usefulness of security telemetry.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Configure and maintain SIEM content, including log sources, parsing, correlation rules, dashboards, alerts, and reports.
* Ingest and normalize security events from cloud, endpoint, network, identity, and application sources.
* Tune detections to reduce noise, improve signal quality, and support timely response.
* Support security tooling across SIEM, vulnerability management, endpoint protection, and CSPM platforms.
* Integrate security alerts and workflows with ServiceNow, Jira, and related ticketing tools.
* Partner with threat detection, incident response, and platform teams to investigate events and improve coverage.
* Maintain documentation, runbooks, policies, and procedures for security tooling and integrations.
* Monitor tool health and data quality, and troubleshoot issues in ingestion, visibility, and alerting.
* Stay current on emerging threats, vulnerabilities, and security best practices.
* Mentor team members and share practical guidance on SIEM engineering and data analysis.

**How You Will Do It**
----------------------

* You take ownership of security outcomes with accountability, integrity, and a strong focus on safe operations.
* You stay close to the work, remove friction for your customers, and focus on the logs, detections, and integrations that matter most.
* You use data, feedback, and root-cause analysis to improve detection quality and make the environment better every day.
* You collaborate across security, IT, and business teams, sharing knowledge and building trust to win as one team.
* You validate changes carefully, document your work clearly, and keep support teams informed so the environment remains reliable and easy to operate.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information security, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 5 to 10 years of experience in IT security, security operations, or security engineering.
* Hands-on experience with SIEM platforms such as Splunk, QRadar, ArcSight, or Logscale.
* Strong understanding of log management, detection engineering, alert tuning, and security event analysis.
* Experience onboarding and maintaining security telemetry from cloud, endpoint, network, identity, and application sources.
* Experience with vulnerability management tools such as Qualys, Tenable.io, or Rapid7.
* Experience with endpoint protection solutions such as CrowdStrike, Carbon Black, or SentinelOne.
* Experience working with CSPM tools such as Palo Alto Prisma, CrowdStrike CSPM, or Sophos Cloud Optix.
* Working knowledge of ServiceNow, Jira, or similar ticketing workflows.
* Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Python or PowerShell scripting experience.
* Experience with Kubernetes security or cloud infrastructure security.
* Certifications such as CompTIA Security+, Splunk Certified User, Splunk Certified Power User, GSEC, CISSP, or CISM.
* Experience supporting SOAR or automation workflows.
* Familiarity with Linux, Windows, or macOS security data sources.

title: Senior Principal Platform Engineer – DevSecOps / DevEx
description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

Keep GSK’s standard company introduction (Ahead Together, portfolio, innovation) unchanged above this section.

The Senior Principal Platform Engineer – DevSecOps / DevEx is the senior technical owner of GSK’s Modern Engineering platforms: Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform, GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, observability and the Nuro AIOps control plane. Every D&T delivery team builds, ships and runs on these platforms, across Azure and GCP, in a GxP-regulated environment.

You run them as secure, self-service products. You set the engineering standard, build golden paths and infrastructure as code instead of manual configuration, and engineer reliability through SLOs, observability and automation. You build agentic AI and AIOps automation that moves the platforms towards self-healing, autonomous operations, with guardrails and human approval where it matters. You treat consuming teams as customers and measure success by adoption, speed and security, not uptime alone.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Platform ownership:** run each platform as a product with SLOs, a capacity plan and a lifecycle (patching, upgrades, end-of-life). Feed engineering-led items into the Product Owner’s backlog, including technical debt and upgrades, with the cost of not doing them stated.
* **Reliability:** achieve 99.9% availability for tier-1 platforms. Lead technical incident response with Reliability Engineering, run blameless post-incident reviews and drive permanent automated fixes instead of repeated manual recovery. Close observability gaps so reliability is measured, not inferred.
* **Everything as code:** manage platform config, policies, pipelines and dashboards in Git through Terraform, Ansible, Helm and GitOps, so provisioning is repeatable. Use AI-assisted engineering across code generation, review and testing, and review AI-generated output before it is merged.
* **Secure by default:** enforce SSO, least-privilege RBAC, secrets management, signed artefacts, branch protection and supply-chain controls (SLSA, SBOM, GitHub Advanced Security) inside the golden path, not bolted on afterwards.
* **Golden paths:** build reusable templates, pipelines and automation content for developer platforms / automation platforms like GitHub, ADO, AAP, Azure/GCP, so delivery teams self-serve without tickets or the platform team’s time.
* **AI Agentic automation:** Design and code agentic AI agents for self-healing and autonomous operations, with human approval gates, guardrails and audit trails.
* **Compliance:** keep platforms in a validated state for GxP, SOX and data-privacy controls, and produce audit evidence automatically from the pipeline.
* **Toolchain rationalisation:** be the technical lead for the platforms strategy, including migration plans, licence optimisation and FinOps for runners and hosting.
* **Developer experience:** measure and improve DORA metrics and platform NPS; work the toil backlog and evidence the effort removed; run onboarding, documentation and office hours.
* **Leadership:** set and uphold engineering standards in design and code review, applying the Platform Architect’s reference architectures and raising a case for change rather than diverging. Mentor internal and partner engineers, hold supplier-delivered work to the same standard, and manage technical relationships with Red Hat, GitHub, Microsoft and Google.

**Education & Professional Qualifications**

  

* Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics).
* Relevant technical certifications desirable (e.g., a recognised cloud certification for AWS, GCP or Azure, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, or a network vendor certification relevant to the platform).
* **Area of Specialisation**
* Hands-on platform engineering in cloud, network or digital workplace, covering infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and containers where relevant.
* Automation-first and secure-by-default engineering, with an SRE mindset covering SLOs, observability and toil reduction.

**Experience Required**

  

* Overall, 15 years and Typically 6-8 years in platform, infrastructure or software engineering, including at least two years as the senior technical voice in a team.
* Proven experience as a DevOps, Cloud Engineer with design experience
* Proficient in building solutions using container services - AKS & GKE
* Hands-on experience deploying container solutions, including Docker containers, and managing K8s deployments using YAML and Helm charts.undefined
* Experience of creating Agentic AI agents for Self-Healing & Autonomous Operations undefined
* Familiarity with service discovery tools like Istio & Mesh undefined
* Expert in using GitHub, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps and other configuration Tools.
* Practical experience of infrastructure-as-code, for example Terraform, applied to production estates rather than proofs of concept.
* Track record building self-service capability that other teams adopted without hand-holding.
* Experience instrumenting for observability, defining SLOs and reducing toil through automation.
* Experience with AI-assisted engineering tooling, including judgement about when generated output is not fit to merge.

**Desirable:**

* Certifications in cloud platforms (e.g. Google Professional Cloud Architect, Azure Solutions Architect Expert).

  

* Familiarity with multi-cloud deployments using cloud tools like Camunda, GitHub Action, Azure Arc, Google Anthos etc.

  

* Understanding of AKS & GKE security practices

  

* Knowledge of Pharma practices, GxP, Validation, Audit readiness and how to optimize delivery to accommodate these critical practices

**Skills/Background**

Automation-first instinct, treating a repeated manual task as a defect rather than as work.

Code review discipline, holding quality without becoming a bottleneck.

Mentoring ability with engineers of varying experience, including partner engineers outside the line.

Judgement about when AI-generated code is fit to merge and when it is not.

Customer mindset toward consuming teams, who can route around a platform that is hard to use.

Willingness to make technical debt and its cost visible rather than absorbing it silently.

**Skills**

Agentic AI, API Management, Automation Technology, Cloud Architectures, Cloud Engineering, Cloud Financial Operations, Containerization, Database Management, DevOps, DevOps Engineering, Disaster Recovery (DR), Docker Kubernetes Architecture, Edge Computing, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Networking Concepts, Performance Optimizations, Serverless Computing, Software Engineering, System Monitors, Virtualization

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. title: Senior Quality Engineer
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
Performance Testing Engineer (AI)
  
JLL | Full-Time
  
About the Role
  
JLL is rolling out AI agents, LLM-powered applications, and the platforms behind them across the business. Before they reach thousands of users, they need to prove they are fast, stable, and affordable at scale.
  
You will own performance engineering for your assigned portfolio of applications and AI systems. The Center of Excellence in our central AI team gives you the methodology, the platform, and the patterns; the business gives you the systems, the SMEs, and the appetite for change. Your job is to design and run load, stress, and resilience tests, find bottlenecks before production does, and turn the results into clear recommendations that teams act on.
  
We expect engineers at this level to operate with AI tools as a primary part of their workflow. You will use AI to generate test scripts, model realistic workloads, analyze results, and automate reporting. Your leverage comes from the skills, workflows, and automations you build to test safely and repeatedly. The leverage in this role is AI, not headcount.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
Design and run performance, load, stress, soak, and scalability tests for applications, APIs, and data pipelines, in close partnership with developers and business SMEs.
  
Performance-test AI systems (LLM gateway, shared RAG services, MCP servers, and agents), measuring time to first token, end-to-end latency, throughput, concurrency limits, rate-limit behavior, and token cost per transaction.
  
**Build AI-assisted test automation:** use LLMs and agents to generate scripts, create realistic synthetic workloads and data, triage results, and draft reports.
  
Integrate performance tests into CI/CD pipelines with SLO-based thresholds and gates so regressions are caught before release.
  
Instrument and monitor systems with observability tooling, diagnose bottlenecks across the application, database, network, and infrastructure layers, and recommend fixes.
  
Build evaluation harnesses that track AI output quality alongside performance, so speed and cost optimizations do not quietly degrade answers.
  
Run workshops with engineering and business teams on performance testing practices and on using tools like Claude Code in testing workflows.
  
Feed benchmarks, patterns, anti-patterns, and platform gaps back into the Center of Excellence so the next engagement moves faster.
  
  
Must Have Experience
  
Hands-on performance testing of production systems using tools such as JMeter, k6, Gatling, or Locust.
  
Production-quality code in at least one of Python, JavaScript/Node, or Java/.NET, enough to build custom load generators and test automation.
  
Experience with observability and APM tools (such as Datadog, Dynatrace, New Relic, Grafana, or Azure Monitor) and with analyzing metrics, traces, and logs to find root causes.
  
Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure (Azure or AWS) and containers, and of how relational, NoSQL, and vector data stores behave under load.
  
Used AI tools or LLM APIs in real engineering or testing workflows, with a grounded understanding of how LLM systems behave under load: token limits, rate limiting, streaming, caching, and concurrency.
  
  
Traits
  
Strong written and verbal communication; able to explain results and risk to non-engineers.
  
Pragmatic judgment on what to test, how deep to go, and when results are good enough to ship.
  
Systems thinking with a focus on failure modes; AI helps write the tests, you own the results.
  
Comfort running multiple agents and automations in parallel as part of daily workflow.
  
  
Why This Role
  
JLL. A Fortune 200 company and a global leader in commercial real estate, with the stability of a $20B+ business and the resources to invest seriously in AI.
  
The team. You sit at the seam of the business, product, and engineering, with a direct line into JLL's central AI platform via the Center of Excellence. Your findings are visible from business leadership on down.
  
The role. The systems you test are the agents and platforms thousands of JLL employees rely on every day, and your work decides whether they hold up at scale. You will see the impact within weeks, not quarters.
  
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet all the requirements. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
At JLL, we harness the power of artificial intelligence (AI) to efficiently accelerate meaningful connections between candidates and opportunities. Using AI capabilities, we analyze your application for relevant skills, experiences, and qualifications to generate valuable insights about how your unique profile aligns with the specific requirements of the role you're pursuing.
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  
Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:
  
  
JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  
About JLL –
  
  
We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  
Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  
Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: Cyber Manager - Threat Exposure Management (Infrastructure)
description:
**Job Role- Cyber Manager**  
The Cyber Manager for Threat Exposure Management is responsible for leading [as a people manager] the enterprise-wide operations, and continual evolution of the organisation’s threat exposure management lifecycle and reduction programmes within a given scope, and reports to the *Senior Cyber Manager – Threat Exposure Management* . This role ensures that exposures across infrastructure, applications, identities, cloud, OT/IoT, AI, and third-party ecosystems are proactively identified, prioritised, validated, and remediated in alignment with business risk and operational resilience requirements.

The successful candidate must demonstrate a strong track record in leading [also as a people manager] high-performing technical teams and fostering a culture of technical excellence. They will bring market-proven know-how to establish industry-driven threat exposure management practices, whilst effectively influencing stakeholders across the organisation. The candidate must also bring advanced technical expertise in threat exposure, vulnerability management and defensive and offensive security, with the ability to lead deep technical discussions and conduct complex analysis across some of the following technologies: IT, OT, Cloud, Applications, Data, Identities, Code and AI-driven environments.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead the technical direction and operational governance of Threat Exposure and Vulnerability Management across heterogeneous environments, including enterprise IT, OT/ICS systems (PLC, SCADA, DCS), multi-cloud architectures (such as Azure, AWS, GCP), container platforms, Kubernetes clusters, application stacks, CI/CD pipelines, Data, Identity, source-code repositories and AI/ML ecosystems.
* Oversee the full threat exposure lifecycle: continuous asset discovery, authenticated scanning, passive/active enumeration, exploitability analysis, threat correlation, prioritisation logic, risk acceptance workflows and exception governance.
* Ensure end-to-end integration with asset intelligence platforms, CMDB, CSPM, vulnerability scanners, code-security toolchains (SAST, SCA, DAST, IaC, secret scanning), and ASM/EASM technologies, establishing high-fidelity visibility across all attack-surface domains.
* Collaborate with Threat Intelligence to operationalise threat-led prioritisation, mapping exploit campaigns, adversary TTPs and industry-specific threat trends to internal exposure data. Align Vulnerability Management (VM) and Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM) with predictive models and real-time intel feeds.
* Direct technical coordination with Red Team and Incident Response to validate exploit paths, confirm actual attack feasibility, and translate validation findings into actionable remediation and control enhancements, partnering with Protect capability and Issues Engineers.
* Govern cloud exposure management across CSPs, ensuring deep visibility into misconfigurations, identity privileges, network paths, storage exposures, API endpoints and container orchestration layers.
* Extend VM and CTEM coverage into OT/ICS environments with risk-aware, non-disruptive methods. Coordinate with OT Security teams to identify vulnerabilities, weak configurations, outdated firmware, and unmanaged assets.
* Manage Vulnerability and Threat Exposure Management across Identity services, including account hygiene, privileged-access pathways, directory health, DNS/DHCP configurations, PKI integrity, authentication flows, domain controller posture, and any identity-linked misconfigurations that create exploitable attack paths.
* Oversee AI/ML exposure across data ingestion pipelines, model training and deployment layers, ensuring identification of risks such as model inversion, data poisoning, prompt injection, insecure model APIs and ungoverned LLM integrations. Operational Excellence & Quality Obsession · Maintain functional metrics and KPIs, delivering performance at or above agreed targets to support operational excellence.
* Develop and uphold operational dashboards, SOPs, workflows, playbooks and service definitions, ensuring high-quality, consistent, standards-driven service delivery.
* Lead remediation governance, risk-acceptance workflows, escalation pathways and exception management processes.
* Enable effective cross-team coordination across Cyber Functions such as Identity, Respond, Detect, Protect, Strategy, Delivery, Platform Engineering, Threat Intelligence, Architecture, Risk, Issues Engineers and Portfolio Cyber Leads. Reporting, Analytics & Metrics
* Deliver comprehensive operational dashboards and KPIs covering key areas of the attack surface such as scanning coverage, vulnerability spread, backlog trends, survival and churn rates, threat posture, exposure windows, exploitability indicators, and Critically Exposed Assets (CEA) pipeline performance.
* Ensure reporting is accurate, timely and aligned to leadership expectations, enabling data-driven decision-making and clear visibility of exposure and progress.
* Maintain structured analytics frameworks to measure remediation effectiveness, prioritisation accuracy and overall functional performance across all attack-surface domains.
* Partner with Operational Insights to provide insights and trend analysis that support continuous improvement, strategic planning and operational excellence across Cyber Operations.

**Relevant Services**

* Threat Exposure Management (TEM)
* Vulnerability Management (VM)
* Attack Surface Management (ASM)
* External Attack Surface Management (EASM)
* Enterprise Surface Discovery (ESD)

**Professional Background**

8–10+ years of progressive experience in enterprise cyber security with demonstrable in-depth technical expertise across Threat Exposure Management, Vulnerability Management, Defensive and Offensive Security, Application Security, Cloud Security, OT/ICS Security, Data and Identity Security, and AI/ML Security. Experience must span large-scale, heterogeneous environments with complex technology stacks. Certifications such as CISSP, CISM and GIAC (GMON, GICSP, GWEB, GCSA) are advantageous, but equivalent hands-on technical capability, advanced analytical proficiency, and a strong record of continuous learning and practical security training are essential.

**Leadership & Communication**

* Proven experience in directly managing a team of Threat Exposure and Vulnerability Management Analysts, including mentoring, developing and guiding security professionals within a collaborative, high-performing environment.
* Strong strategic and visionary capabilities, with the ability to co-develop and drive the function’s technical vision, strategy and roadmap in alignment with business objectives and the organisation’s threat appetite. Technical Expertise
* Deep knowledge of vulnerability management, threat exposure management, exploit development concepts, exposure validation, and remediation governance.
* Strong understanding of common security vulnerabilities, attack vectors, and security testing frameworks, such as OWASP, MITRE ATT&CK, CVE / CVSS, and NIST SP 800-53.
* Robust expertise across technical domains such as IT, OT, Cloud, network security, container environments, and identity-centric security. · Proven capability in AppSec, secure coding practices, CI/CD and IaC security, and DevSecOps tooling.
* Solid understanding of AI/ML architecture, AI security threats, LLM exposure risks, and secure integration patterns.
* Hands-on expertise with tooling in different landscapes: VM, ASM/EASM, AppSec, Cloud, OT, Data, Identity, AI. Stakeholder Engagement & Culture
* Serve as the advisor and central point of contact for all Threat Exposure and Vulnerability Management matters across the organisation within a given scope.
* Build strong relationships with industry partners, vendors, and the wider technology ecosystem to incorporate external expertise, benchmark performance, and stay ahead of emerging threats and vulnerability trends.
* Develop trusted relationships across Cyber, Portfolio teams, Engineering, and Business functions, anchored in transparency, accountability, and the organisation’s core values.
* Lead by example in strengthening collaboration, breaking down silos, and cultivating high-performing cross-functional networks.
* Promote a values-driven culture that embraces diversity, inclusion, and collective ownership of cyber risk.
* Champion staff education, awareness, and secure behaviours to embed a proactive, cyber-aware mindset across the organisation.
* Foster a responsive, delivery-focused culture that partners effectively with Technology and Business units to drive timely resolutions and value-led security outcomes.

title: Advanced Software Engr
description:
Honeywell is looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer to help build and evolve enterprise-scale platform services supporting Honeywell Forge and the Cognition platform.

You will work closely with technical leads, architects, SRE, cybersecurity, QA, product, and other engineering teams to translate product and architecture requirements into secure, scalable, maintainable, and production-ready software. **Core Technical Qualifications**

* Modern full-stack application development

* Web application architecture and modern frontend engineering

* RESTful APIs and backend service development

* .NET and C# development

* Microservices and distributed-system concepts

* Event-driven architecture and asynchronous processing
* + RabbitMQ or comparable enterprise messaging technology
* + SQL and relational databases, particularly PostgreSQL or comparable platforms

* + Authentication, authorization, and secure API design
